desc: First draft of the European SACT Regimen Catalog FHIR IG
introduction: The European SACT Regimen Catalog defines a shared, computable representation of Systemic Anti-Cancer Therapy regimen definitions to support consistent prescribing, safety checking, and secondary use of oncology treatment data across Europe.
